meta: Ask AI to help you understand an employment contract before signing, so you don't find the unfavorable terms only when trouble starts.

muc.title: Sign first, read later
muc.text: Many people sign an employment contract and read it later, only finding the unfavorable terms when trouble starts.

muc.title: Cover personal details
muc.text: Before pasting into a chatbot, delete your name, ID number, the company name and the exact salary.

muc.title: Four sections to check
muc.text: Ask AI to explain four sections simply: probation, hours and overtime, days off, and termination terms.

muc.title: Bring your questions
muc.text: AI helps you understand and draft questions. Ask HR about anything unclear, and a lawyer about major terms.

muc.title: Three questions to ask
muc.text: Paste a section of a contract with names removed and ask a chatbot for three questions to ask before signing.
